verdict.rationale: Morph is a paid, token-billed LLM API platform, so spending caps and budget alerts are a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no spending cap, budget limit, or billing alert. Rate limits, half-price standby requests, prefix caching and dedicated capacity are adjacent cost or throughput controls, not caps that bound a bill.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
